# InitMap

**Author:** Siemens AG<br/>
**Platforms:** x35/x45/x55 (EGOLD)

Official Siemens service software for writing mapping files to the phone.
Mapping contains factory and regional device settings; InitMap checks
that the model and software version data match and writes standard and delta blocks.

Version 1.36 supports C35, S35, M35, A35, A36, A40, SL45, C45, ME45, S45,
M50, MT50, A50, 3118, and C55, including Chinese variants. Supported systems are
Windows 95, 98, NT, and 2000.
